verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gusto publishes its own Dev Assistant MCP server for external AI tools such as Cursor and Claude Desktop to use. That is the server role. Nothing shows that Gusto itself can connect to or consume third-party MCP servers as a client. The server, CLI and API evidence comes from different stories and does not transfer here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
